description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ProvisioningJournalEntriesCannotbeCreatedException' used in the provisioning module of the accounting component, extending a platform-specific exception class to handle cases where journal entries cannot be created due to date conflicts.

classes.name: ProvisioningJournalEntriesCannotbeCreatedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that provisioning journal entries cannot be created on a later date than existing entries.

methods.name: ProvisioningJournalEntriesCannotbeCreatedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with existing and requested dates, passing a formatted message to the superclass.
